records.title: ESTABLISHMENT OF CENTRAL INSTITUTE OF YOGA AND NATUROPATHY IN ODISHA
details:
(a) & (b): The Central Council for Research in Yoga and Naturopathy (CCRYN) under
the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, proposes to set up a Central Research
Institute for Yoga and Naturopathy (CRIYN) in Odisha. Government of Odisha has
now identified an alternate land measuring 15.00 Acres in Jatni Tehsil, District Khorda
for establishment of CRIYN and the process for handover of this land is underway.

records.title: Artificial Intelligence Courses in Secondary Schools
details:
Currently, arrangements are being made to teach computer science and
